input: How do we verify webhook signatures?: What algorithm does the X-TaskFlow-Signature header use?
reply_excerpt: To verify webhook signatures, compute an HMAC-SHA256 of the raw request body using your endpoint secret, then compare it with the value of the X-TaskFlow-Signature header using a constant-time comparison.

reply_excerpt: To verify that a webhook came from TaskFlow, your receiver should check the X-TaskFlow-Signature header. Compute an HMAC-SHA256 of the raw request body using your endpoint secret, and compare it to the header value using a constant-time comparison to prevent timing attacks.
